title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-xy4c: fragments_in_window_vec fix correct but crate has 11 remaining compilation errors
description:
The commit fixes `fragments_in_window_vec` (replacing call to non-existent `fragments_in_window` with correct inline filter on `self.iter()`). The fix itself is correct.

However, `cargo check -p lichen-schc --features std` still fails with 11 errors:
- `fragment.rs:1104`: rule_id: 0 should be Option<u8> (FragmentReceiver::new)
- `fragment.rs:1177-1179`: rule_id type mismatch in FragmentReceiver::ingest tests
- `fragment.rs:1230,1249,1273`: Ack::new argument count mismatch (8 args supplied, function signature changed?)
- `headers.rs:465,666,840,992`: write_ipv6_header takes 7 args but 8 supplied

These are pre-existing errors from the broader worker6 changes not addressed by this commit. The crate does not compile and tests cannot run.
